product_description: Automated expense management platform for finance teams that uses AI to categorize receipts, detect policy violations, reconcile with corporate cards, and generate real-time spend reports.
business_objective: Eliminate manual expense reporting and reduce finance team overhead at mid-market companies
icp: Companies with 200-2000 employees, finance teams of 5-20 people, frequent business travel
user_persona: Employees submitting expenses, finance team processing and approving
existing_workflow: Employees photograph receipts, submit via email or spreadsheet, manager approves in email, finance manually enters into accounting system (NetSuite/QuickBooks)
